explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and D2 step and only fires at GO, mostly when choosing a1: right after one or two unrewarded trials it is 9-10, and each consecutive rewarded trial lowers it by about 2 (8, 6, 4, ... down to 0), so long reward streaks give 0, and it is higher early in the episode (trials 1-35) than later. Choosing a2 gives 0, except on the first one or two a2 trials right after losing on a1 (about 4-8).
